nm RECONCILIATION DIFFERENCES to resolve downstream with filing evidence (dataqa_resolutions): (1) D&A FY2025: pf_d_and_a_fy2025 = 5,030M but the 10-K cash-flow line 'Depreciation, amortization and impairment' = 6,148M (Alpha Vantage 6,148M); the pf tag is narrower (depreciation excluding impairment and some amortization), so use the filing figure for EBITDA or maintenance-capex work. (2) Alpha Vantage quarterly netIncome is inconsistent across quarters: Q1 2026 491M (that is net income including noncontrolling interests; attributable to common 477M per pf), Q2 1,114M and Q3 787M (attributable). Use pf / 10-Q attributable figures. (3) Alpha Vantage commonStockSharesOutstanding (3,528M FY2025, 3,541M Q3 2026) is the diluted WEIGHTED average, not point-in-time shares outstanding. (4) Alpha Vantage shortLongTermDebtTotal 16,445M at 2026-09-30 does not tie to the 10-Q: debt note total debt 9,284M (current 1,311M + non-current 7,956M, these two match Alpha Vantage currentLongTermDebt and longTermDebt), plus finance leases = 9,523M on the balance sheet (current 1,387M + non-current 8,136M); use the 10-Q. (5) Alpha Vantage totalLiabilities 67,682M = 10-Q total liabilities 67,628M + 54M redeemable noncontrolling interests.

nm SHARES (point in time, for ownership and dilution): 10-Q cover 3,952,757,946 shares outstanding at 2026-10-15; balance sheet 3,953M issued and outstanding at 2026-09-30 versus 3,751M at 2025-12-31. This count includes restricted stock awards that are NOT in the EPS share counts until earned (10-Q: 'Restricted stock awards will be excluded from the computation of diluted weighted average shares until the shares have been deemed to be earned'): weighted basic 3,240M and diluted 3,541M in Q3 2026 (stock-based awards add 301M; 17M anti-dilutive excluded). The 2025 CEO Performance Award (SBC 275M in Q3, 802M for nine months; 9.74B unrecognized for milestones judged probable, 105.82B to 120.37B for milestones not probable) is the main reason; per-share value must be taken on a share count that reflects it. Use point-in-time shares for ownership, weighted shares only for EPS.

nm BALANCE SHEET 2026-09-30 (10-Q): cash and cash equivalents 17,853M, short-term investments 27,594M (of which 231M restricted for the insurance business), together 45,447M fair value; restricted cash outside these (489M current, 664M non-current) and digital assets 962M (11,509 Bitcoin at cost 386M) are kept apart from spendable cash. Debt and finance leases 9,523M; total assets 157,517M; total liabilities 67,628M; stockholders' equity 89,289M; noncontrolling interests 546M plus redeemable 54M. Unused committed credit 30,000M in the debt note (5,000M at 2025-12-31).

nm ROIC CHECK: prefetch/forensic.json roic is 'unavailable' (it needs operating income, equity, debt and cash per year), so no prefetch ROIC to check; recomputed by hand. Invested capital at 2026-09-30 = equity 89,289 + noncontrolling 546 + redeemable 54 + debt and finance leases 9,523 - cash and short-term investments 45,447 = 53,965M; at 2025-12-31 = 82,137 + 670 + 58 + 8,376 - 44,059 = 47,182M. Digital assets (962M), restricted cash and operating lease liabilities are left out of both. Trailing operating income 3,466M (Q4'25 1,409 + Q1 941 + Q2 398 + Q3 718) at an assumed 21% tax = NOPAT about 2,738M, ROIC about 5.1% on the net-of-cash base (about 2.8% if the 45.4B of cash and investments is not netted). FY2025 NOPAT about 3,440M on 47,182M = 7.3%. Incremental: invested capital +6,783M while NOPAT -702M, so incremental ROIC is negative (about -10%) on this window; the investment is front-loaded (nine-month capex 13.0B versus 6.1B a year earlier; construction in progress sits in PP&E 50,591M versus 40,643M, other non-current assets 12,599M versus 5,045M). The 21% tax rate is my assumption (10-Q effective rate 16% in Q3 and 20% for nine months).

Forward P/E on the EPS REALISED over the next four quarters (a hindsight proxy, NOT the consensus of the time, which is not available), 16 points 2021-12 to 2025-09: low 28.6, median 103.1, high 488.7. Caution: trailing EPS 2023 to 2024 (4.30 for FY2023) is lifted by a one-time tax benefit (FY2023 income tax was a 5.0B benefit with pre-tax income 9.97B and net income 15.0B in history.json; the 10-K tax reconciliation shows a valuation-allowance change of 5,962M), so the low multiples of 2022 to 2024 rest on earnings that were inflated or at a cyclical peak; current EPS (0.91 trailing) is depressed by heavy R&D (Q3 2.76B, 10% of revenue versus 6%) and a 3.35B nine-month SBC charge, so a trailing P/E near 446 is not a normal-earnings multiple either.

nm TRACK RECORD revenue: no ratio is possible. None of the eight saved earnings releases (2026-01-02 to 2026-10-21, the Q4 2025 to Q3 2026 updates and the delivery reports) gives a numeric revenue, EPS, margin or delivery guide; each Outlook section is qualitative (volume, cash, profit, product). The only numeric guide is capital expenditure as a floor, not a range: FY2026 capex 'in excess of $20 billion' (10-K, filed 2026-01-29), raised to 'in excess of $25 billion' (10-Q filed 2026-04-23 and 2026-07-23) and CUT back to 'in excess of $20 billion' (10-Q filed 2026-10-22, still 'driven by our SI initiatives'); nine-month capex is 13.0B, so the floor implies Q4 capex of at least 7.0B against 4.7B in Q3 (hand it to gather_documents for guidance items). FY2025: the FY2024 10-K (filed 2025-01-30) is not among the saved documents, so the prior-year capex guide versus the 8,527M delivered could not be checked (gap). guidance_track is therefore empty; the engine applies no track-record adjustment.
